title: Masala Dragon
style: 3D animated movie still in the style of a Pixar film, cute expressive characters with big eyes, exaggerated funny facial expressions, vibrant colors, soft cinematic lighting, vertical 9:16

narrator.look: A gentle female storyteller, warm expression.

Priya.look: A graceful Indian woman in her early 30s, fair skin, long soft wavy dark-brown hair, a small red bindi, wearing an elegant pastel green saree. Her face shows a mix of concern and eventual amusement.

Aarav.look: An 8-year-old Indian boy, light wheatish skin, bright, curious eyes, short black hair, wearing a blue t-shirt and khaki shorts. He is energetic and loving towards his pet.

Sparky.look: A tiny, adorable baby dragon with shimmering emerald green scales, large, expressive golden eyes, small budding wings, and two tiny horns. It has a mischievous yet innocent expression.

scenes.image: CLOSE UP: Aarav (8, blue t-shirt) excitedly holds up Sparky (baby dragon, emerald green scales) towards Priya (pastel green saree) who looks shocked, mouth slightly open. They are in a brightly lit living room.
scenes.speaker: Aarav

scenes.image: Priya (pastel green saree), eyes wide with alarm, recoils slightly. Sparky (baby dragon) looks up innocently from Aarav's hands.
scenes.speaker: Priya
scenes.line: Aarav, yeh kaun sa janwar hai?
scenes.say: आरव, यह कौन सा जानवर है?

scenes.image: Sparky (baby dragon) is perched on a kitchen counter next to a bowl of vegetables, sniffing curiously. Priya (pastel green saree) watches from a distance, looking worried.
scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.line: Chhota Sparky humare ghar ka mehmaan ban gaya.
scenes.say: छोटा स्पार्की हमारे घर का मेहमान बन गया।

scenes.image: Sparky (baby dragon) has just breathed a tiny puff of fire on a dosa on a tawa. The dosa is slightly charred. Priya (pastel green saree) rushes forward, looking panicked.
scenes.speaker: Priya

scenes.image: Priya (pastel green saree) points a finger at Sparky (baby dragon) sternly. Sparky looks down, appearing scolded, on the counter.
scenes.speaker: Priya

scenes.image: Sparky (baby dragon) is now breathing fire on a shiny steel karahi, leaving a black scorch mark. Priya (pastel green saree) throws her hands up in exasperation.
scenes.speaker: Priya
scenes.line: Yeh kya kar rahe ho? Meri karahi!
scenes.say: यह क्या कर रहे हो? मेरी कड़ाही!

scenes.image: Priya (pastel green saree) is wiping a smoky counter with a frustrated expression, looking towards Sparky (baby dragon) who is peeking from behind a spice jar.
scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.line: Har din kuch naya hungama karta tha.
scenes.say: हर दिन कुछ नया हंगामा करता था।

scenes.image: CLOSE UP: Sparky (baby dragon) with a sad, confused expression, eyes slightly downcast. Smoke curls faintly in the background.
scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.line: Use samajh nahi aa raha tha.
scenes.say: उसे समझ नहीं आ रहा था।

scenes.image: Priya (pastel green saree) gently holds Sparky's (baby dragon) tiny paw, trying to explain something with a calm, teaching expression in the kitchen.
scenes.speaker: Priya
scenes.line: Beta, aag sirf ghar ke bahar.
scenes.say: बेटा, आग सिर्फ घर के बाहर।

scenes.image: Sparky (baby dragon) is excitedly perched on Priya's shoulder while she is chopping vegetables. Sparky looks eager, ready to 'help'.
scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.line: Par Sparky toh madad karna chahta tha.
scenes.say: पर स्पार्की तो मदद करना चाहता था।

scenes.image: CHAOS: The kitchen is filled with light smoke. Sparky (baby dragon) breathes a stream of fire towards a cooking pot. Priya (pastel green saree) looks utterly bewildered and stressed.
scenes.speaker: Priya
scenes.line: Bas! Bahut ho gaya yeh sab!
scenes.say: बस! बहुत हो गया यह सब!

scenes.image: Priya (pastel green saree), with an angry but desperate face, points a finger at Sparky (baby dragon). Sparky cowers slightly on the counter.
scenes.speaker: Priya
scenes.line: Sparky, tum yeh aag kyun nikalte ho?
scenes.say: स्पार्की, तुम यह आग क्यों निकालते हो?

scenes.image: CLOSE UP: Sparky (baby dragon) looks up at Priya with big, innocent eyes. A small puff of smoke comes from its nose. It speaks with a child-like voice.
scenes.speaker: Sparky
scenes.line: Khane mein masala nahi tha, Mummy!
scenes.say: खाने में मसाला नहीं था, मम्मी!

scenes.image: Priya (pastel green saree) freezes, then her angry face slowly turns into disbelief, then a slight, bewildered smile. She looks at Sparky (baby dragon) with understanding.
scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.line: Uski baat sunkar Priya hairaan reh gayi.
scenes.say: उसकी बात सुनकर प्रिया हैरान रह गई।

scenes.image: OVERHEAD SHOT: The kitchen is a mess – scorched counter, a half-burnt roti, a smoking karahi. Sparky (baby dragon) sits innocently amidst the chaos.
scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.line: Woh toh bas hamare khane ko teekha kar raha tha.
scenes.say: वह तो बस हमारे खाने को तीखा कर रहा था।

scenes.image: Priya (pastel green saree) stands in the smoky kitchen, a wry smile on her face, shaking her head. Sparky (baby dragon) looks expectantly at her.
scenes.speaker: Priya
scenes.line: Aapke ghar aisa dragon ho toh kya karti? Rakhti ya bhejti?
scenes.say: आपके घर ऐसा ड्रैगन हो तो क्या करती? रखती या भेजती?

caption: My Son's New Pet Breathes Fire! 🔥
yt_title: My Son's New Pet Breathes Fire! 🔥
description: My son brought home a 'lizard' that turned our kitchen into a fiery mess. But when I confronted it, its reason was hilariously unexpected! What would YOU do?
comment_question: Aapke ghar aisa dragon ho toh kya karti? Rakhti ya bhejti?
